goal: Refresh the Electron KitCode setup window to match the reference two-column layout with a decorative step rail, reference header, dashed project empty state, and stronger selected-option treatment while preserving all existing onboarding behavior.

in: Restructure `onboarding-window.mjs` into a two-column shell: left step rail plus right scrollable configuration panel with all three sections visible at once.
Replace the intro block and terminal tab chrome with a reference header: brand icon, `KITCODE SETUP`, and `local-first setup` with a red status dot; keep platform-specific close controls only.
Add a decorative step rail with numbered badges for tracking, projects, and companion view; highlight the active section via scroll/focus spy.
Restyle section titles and selected option cards to match the reference, including red-border glow on selected `[x]` options.
Render the projects empty state as a dashed drop zone with a folder icon and `No projects added`; keep the existing native `+ ADD PROJECTS` picker behavior.
Update the primary CTA copy to `SAVE & OPEN KITCODE ->` while preserving save, retry, validation, and disabled/busy behavior.
Preserve all existing `data-testid` selectors, radio-group semantics, keyboard handlers, IPC bridge usage, and recoverable save states.
Update focused onboarding checks to assert the new layout markers without changing onboarding flow contracts.
out: No step wizard that hides sections.
No clickable sidebar navigation in v1.
No web dashboard setup gateway changes.
No per-OS body styling variants beyond existing close-control chrome.
No changes to tracker, reward, local-state schema, or companion launch behavior.

acceptance_criteria.summary: Setup renders a left step rail and right main panel with all three configuration sections visible; the old intro eyebrow/lead block is removed.
The header shows brand icon plus `KITCODE SETUP` and `local-first setup` with a red status dot instead of the `kitcode-setup` terminal tab label.
The left rail highlights the active section based on scroll position or focused content inside the main panel; all sections remain visible and the rail is decorative only.
When no projects are present, the project collection shows a dashed empty zone with a folder icon and `No projects added`; populated state keeps bounded scrollable rows.

The refresh reuses the existing setup semantic tokens (`--bg`, `--panel`, `--line`, `--primary`, `--text`, `--muted`, monospace stack) and established option-row/statusline patterns instead of introducing a second palette.

Auto-track YES/NO, cumulative project picker, pending removal, preferences-only save, save/retry states, keyboard navigation, and stable `data-testid` selectors behave exactly as before the visual refresh.

coverage_plan.summary: Assert the new layout markers, reference header, step rail spy hooks, dashed empty state, CTA copy, and unchanged functional selectors.
Keep pet/onboarding script assertions aligned with the refreshed setup chrome markers.

risks.summary: The sidebar reduces horizontal space for project rows and option cards in the fixed setup window.
risks.mitigation: Keep the project list scrollable, preserve ellipsis handling, and tune rail width and section spacing during implementation.

risks.summary: Fast keyboard focus changes or short sections can make the rail highlight flicker.
risks.mitigation: Combine IntersectionObserver with focusin updates and use conservative visibility thresholds.

risks.summary: Focused onboarding checks currently assert the old `kitcode-setup` tab label and single-column structure.
risks.mitigation: Update `check-onboarding-window.mjs` and `check-pet-window.mjs` in the same change set.

implementation_handoff.summary: Reskin the generated setup HTML/CSS/inline script in `onboarding-window.mjs` and adjust `onboarding-platform.mjs` header chrome to match the reference layout without touching Electron IPC or persistence.
design_system_refs: Reuse the existing setup semantic CSS variables and monospace stack already defined in `onboarding-window.mjs`.
Reuse terminal option-row and statusline composition patterns from `terminal-window.mjs` for selected states and footer chrome.
Do not introduce a second shared React component library; this surface remains generated HTML inside the CLI package.
suggested_sequence: Update `renderPlatformChrome` to the reference header while preserving platform close controls.
Restructure setup markup into workspace grid with step rail and scrollable main panel.
Restyle sections, option cards, dashed empty state, and CTA copy.
Add scroll/focus spy for the rail and keep all existing bridge logic intact.
Update focused onboarding checks and run them.
